definitions.explanation: A building used for public meetings, gatherings, or as a center for a particular organization.

examples.japanese: {市民|しみん}{会館|かいかん}でコンサートがある。
examples.english: There's a concert at the civic hall.

examples.japanese: {結婚式|けっこんしき}を{会館|かいかん}で{挙|あ}げた。
examples.english: We held the wedding ceremony at the hall.

examples.japanese: {日本|にほん}には{各地|かくち}に{文化|ぶんか}{会館|かいかん}がある。
examples.english: There are cultural centers throughout Japan.

notes:
USAGE: {会館|かいかん} appears as a suffix in names of public buildings.

COMMON COMPOUNDS:
・{市民|しみん}{会館|かいかん} (civic hall)
・{文化|ぶんか}{会館|かいかん} (cultural center)
・{県民|けんみん}{会館|かいかん} (prefectural hall)
・{商工|しょうこう}{会館|かいかん} (chamber of commerce building)
・{婦人|ふじん}{会館|かいかん} (women's center)

SIMILAR BUILDINGS:
・ホール - hall (from English)
・{公民館|こうみんかん} - community center
・{公会堂|こうかいどう} - public hall

RELATED:
・{会場|かいじょう} - venue (for specific events)
